name: Fresh Gemini answer and evidence development comparison
notes: Both recordings and all questions are development data using human annotations, not trained detector outputs or held-out accuracy.
Reviews are independent AI-assisted judgments; student/human verification remains pending. Joint grades require acceptable answer content/status and target evidence; raw QA grades are also preserved.
The baseline combines the newly requested31-question live trial with the previous five live scene checks. Two of the31 had only HTTP503 outcomes. These errors remain in the fixed cohort.

All36 grounded-v1 answers completed as fresh responses using requested and provider-reported gemini-3.5-flash-lite. This frozen complete cohort executed source80aaa0d; later fixes are separate focused tests.
Multiple components changed: visual selection, derived facts, image views and endpoint handling. Differences do not establish a causal training effect.
The latest source has no complete live rerun: a daily500-request free-tier quota stopped pilot07 after successful selection but before its answer.
Raw run folders/images remain local and ignored by Git. Review bindings hash the exact results and all audited artifacts. No gold answer key is used for inference or this offline QA comparison.
